en.topic_title: Hong Kong arrests 9 over fuel smuggling as oil prices surge

zh.topic_title: Hong Kong arrests 9 over fuel smuggling as oil prices surge

en.topic_title: Hong Kong arrests 9 over fuel smuggling as oil prices surge
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong arrested nine people in a city-wide operation targeting illicit fuel activities, authorities said on Wednesday, as surging global oil prices continue to put pressure on the import-dependent financial hub.



An illicit motor spirit storage site raided in the joint operation. Photo: Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department.



The city lacks its own refineries and imports its entire supply of automotive fuel, with much of it coming from neighbouring mainland China.
